# `clients/portal-dev-agui/vendor/agent-widget.iife.js`

Source: [`clients/portal-dev-agui/vendor/agent-widget.iife.js`](../../../../../../clients/portal-dev-agui/vendor/agent-widget.iife.js)

> **Summary:** A vendored, minified build of `clients/agent-widget` (`dist/agent-widget.iife.js`) that includes `AgUiTransport`. It is here so the AG-UI local stack works without building the widget.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Layer | Portal stand-in |
| Rebuild | `cd clients/agent-widget && npm run build`, then copy `dist/agent-widget.iife.js` here |

Don't edit it by hand. `clients/portal-dev/vendor` keeps the older build without `AgUiTransport`.
